item.description: Around 1,000 additional deaths than average have been recorded in France during the country's current heatwave, the National Health Authority reported on Sunday. Around 85% of the recorded deaths were among people aged 65 and over, Santé publique France said.

item.title: Istanbul bans Pride march again amid growing crackdown on LGBTQ rights
item.description: Activists have strongly condemned the ban on Sunday's annual Pride parade in the Turkish metropolis of Istanbul.
